prompt: Drivers on Lake Baikal (not / to allow / leave) the flagged ice lane.
explanation_ru: Запрет в пассиве: be not allowed + to-инфинитив. Водителям не разрешают съезжать с трассы.

prompt: I (to make / collect) three signatures from different deans before getting my grant.
explanation_ru: После пассивного make обязательно ставится частица to: was made to collect.

prompt: In small Roman pharmacies, customers (not / to allow / pick) items off the shelves.
explanation_ru: Конструкция be not allowed to do описывает правило, действующее постоянно (Present Simple).

prompt: Petrol cars (not / to allow / enter) the streets of Zermatt, so electric carts carry luggage.
explanation_ru: Постоянный запрет в пассиве: are not allowed to enter.

prompt: Visiting sixth-formers (to ask / leave) their watches in a tray outside the Faraday cage.
explanation_ru: Правило безопасности в настоящем времени: be asked + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Are Oxford students really (to allow / ask) for a free pint of beer during exams?
explanation_ru: В вопросе вспомогательный глагол Are уже вынесен в начало, остаётся allowed + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Dog owners (to expect / keep) their pets on a lead near the park pond.
explanation_ru: Формальное требование на табличке: be expected + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Why (diplomatic bags / not / to make / go) through airport X-ray scanners like ordinary luggage?

blanks.cue: diplomatic bags / not / to make / go
blanks.answer: are diplomatic bags not made to go
accepted_answers: are diplomatic bags not made to go
aren't diplomatic bags made to go

explanation_ru: Отрицательный вопрос в пассиве с make: после made обязательно нужен инфинитив с to (to go).

prompt: Road-train drivers (to make / unhook) their massive trailers at the city perimeter because they cannot fit on roundabouts.
explanation_ru: Водителей заставляют отцеплять прицепы (регулярное правило). В пассиве после make ставится to.

prompt: Before stepping past the yellow magnetic-field line, I (to tell / remove) even my metal hairclips.
explanation_ru: Пассивная конструкция be told + to-инфинитив: мне велели снять заколки.

prompt: The server outage in Oregon (to make / us / sit) in a completely dark hallway when we got home.
explanation_ru: Здесь активный залог (сбой заставил нас сидеть), поэтому после make частица to не ставится.

prompt: At Sydney customs, wood-boring beetles (to hear / chew) loudly inside a tourist's wooden carving.
explanation_ru: Глагол восприятия hear в пассиве: чтобы показать процесс, используется причастие (were heard chewing).

prompt: Our shy new intern (to hear / sing) brilliantly at karaoke, so everyone immediately demanded an encore.
explanation_ru: После пассивного hear нельзя ставить голый инфинитив (sing) — нужно либо -ing (процесс), либо to sing.

prompt: In Arbroath, salted haddock (to leave / hang) over smouldering oak barrels for forty-five minutes until copper-gold.
explanation_ru: Регулярный процесс копчения: рыбу оставляют висеть (is left to hang / hanging).

prompt: Because the frosted film only covered the middle of the glass, the directors' shoes (to see / kick) under the table.
explanation_ru: Пассив с глаголом восприятия see + -ing подчёркивает, что действие было видно в процессе.

prompt: During a force-seven gale, the newly qualified pilot (to see / climb) the rope ladder up the ship's hull.
explanation_ru: В пассиве после see используется -ing (процесс) или инфинитив с to (завершённое действие), но не голый инфинитив.

prompt: No examiner (to allow / destroy) written exam booklets until thirteen months have passed after results day.
explanation_ru: Отрицание уже выражено словом No, поэтому глагол стоит в утвердительной форме пассива: is allowed to destroy.

prompt: After the triumphal scene in Verona, stage sweepers (to make / vacuum) forty barrow-loads of red confetti in twelve minutes.
explanation_ru: Регулярная обязанность в театре: после пассивного make обязательно требуется to.

prompt: Before it was cleared for launch, the camera lens assembly (to make / spin) at twelve G on an eight-metre arm.
explanation_ru: Инженеры заставили блок вращаться (пассив в прошлом: was made + to-инфинитив).

prompt: Because master passwords are encrypted locally, company staff (not / to allow / access) your vault even under a court order.
explanation_ru: Сотрудникам не разрешено (и технически невозможно) получать доступ: are not allowed to access.

prompt: In fifteenth-century Estonia, anyone who (to catch / throw) rubbish into the market well faced a heavy fine.
explanation_ru: После пассивного catch (быть пойманным за чем-либо) используется причастие с -ing: was caught throwing.

prompt: During the Melbourne tramway test, a dummy pram (to see / roll) onto the wet rails from behind a parked van.
explanation_ru: Описание стандартного теста в Present Simple. После пассивного see ставится -ing или to-инфинитив.

prompt: Our Pyrenean campsite laundry has strict hours. Guests (not / to allow / use) ordinary coins in the machines. Instead, we (to ask / buy) brass tokens from the bread van between eight and nine.
explanation_ru: Оба пропуска описывают действующие правила кемпинга в пассиве: be not allowed to do и be asked to do.

prompt: Security in this Singapore hotel is tight. Visitors (not / to allow / press) the residential floor buttons without a keycard. The system (to make / you / tap) your card against the brass reader first.
explanation_ru: В первом случае пассив с to (are not allowed to press). Во втором — активный глагол make, после которого to не ставится (makes you tap).

prompt: My teenage son in Oslo never cleans up on his own. Yesterday, I (to make / him / tidy) his bedroom before his mates arrived. He (to hear / grumble) loudly behind the closed door for twenty minutes.
explanation_ru: В активном залоге после made нет to (made him tidy). В пассивном предложении с hear используется -ing (was heard grumbling).

prompt: Six interrailers learnt the Ljubljana hostel rules the hard way. All guests (to tell / write) their name and checkout date on fridge items. Unlabelled food is declared free at nine, so we watched as our own yoghurt (to eat) by a stranger!
explanation_ru: are told to write — гостям велят (правило). Йогурт съел незнакомец — пассив was eaten / was being eaten.

prompt: Before the Tbilisi cable car opens at seven, engineers run a safety check. Passengers (not / to allow / board) until an empty cabin full of sandbags completes a full trip. That test car (to see / glide) over the gorge every morning at dawn.
explanation_ru: Запрет в пассиве (are not allowed to board) и глагол восприятия see в пассиве с -ing (is seen gliding) для описания регулярного процесса.

prompt: Our health centre in Inverness recently upgraded its reception. Patients (to encourage / use) the new touchscreen kiosk in Gaelic or Polish. Because it prints a numbered slip, nobody's name (to hear / echo) across the waiting room anymore.
explanation_ru: В первом случае пассив с инфинитивом (are encouraged to use). Во втором — пассивный глагол восприятия hear + -ing.

prompt: Chinese New Year traditions are taken seriously in our London family. Children (to allow / open) their red envelopes only after wishing their elders good health. However, relatives (to expect / avoid) giving any amount containing the number four.
explanation_ru: Обе части описывают семейные правила в настоящем времени: be allowed + to-инфинитив и be expected + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Running a steam locomotive in Pickering requires an early start. Volunteer firemen (to make / light) the boiler with oily rags five hours before departure. Until the pressure gauge hits the red mark, the driver (not / to allow / move) the engine out of the shed.
explanation_ru: После пассивного make ставится to (are made to light). Во втором пропуске — запрет в пассиве (is not allowed to move).

prompt: Police horses in London undergo months of calm desensitisation. Before stadium duty, each horse (to make / walk) over rustling tarpaulins and smoke flares. Trainers never (to let / a horse / panic); instead, they reward every steady step.
explanation_ru: В пассиве после make нужно to (is made to walk). Глагол let используется в активе без частицы to (let a horse panic).

prompt: Our Kraków payroll office gave everyone a surprise before the holidays. Although salaries arrived three days early, a server bug (to make / the payslips / show) the year 1970. Several confused staff members (to hear / joke) about getting paid in vintage banknotes.
explanation_ru: Активный make не требует to (made the payslips show). Пассивный hear + -ing (were heard joking) передаёт процесс.

prompt: Whenever the coastguard helicopter approaches Plymouth hospital, pedestrians ___ cross the roof car park.
explanation_ru: Глагол let не употребляется в пассиве; для запрета используется be not allowed + to-инфинитив.

prompt: At our Warsaw Christmas Eve dinner, an empty chair ___ at the table for an unexpected guest.
options: is always expected to be left
explanation_ru: Ожидается, что стул будет оставлен: is expected + пассивный инфинитив to be left.

prompt: Before trading in a tablet in Birmingham, customers ___ sign out of their cloud accounts.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после глагола make обязательно нужна частица to: are made to sign out.

prompt: In medieval Bruges, merchants ___ break the wax seal on a contract unless the deal was officially cancelled.
explanation_ru: Глагол let не образует пассив (weren't let). Правильно: weren't allowed to break.

prompt: In that Brighton café, regulars ___ bring their own reusable cups in exchange for a discount and a biscuit.
explanation_ru: После пассивного encourage требуется инфинитив с частицей to: are encouraged to bring.

prompt: During the Champagne harvest, workers ___ pick every bunch by hand because machines would crush the grapes.
explanation_ru: После пассивного make всегда ставится to-инфинитив: are made to pick.

prompt: For over a century, the international kilogram cylinder ___ only when three separate keyholders were present.
explanation_ru: Цилиндр разрешалось открывать: was allowed + пассивный инфинитив to be uncovered. Let в пассиве не используется.

prompt: On the Oban research vessel, a brass weight ___ down the steel cable to trigger the deep-water bottles.
explanation_ru: После пассивного make ставится to-инфинитив (is made to slide). Вариант 'to sliding' грамматически неверен.

prompt: Joggers in Madrid are not allowed using the park fountains after midnight.
answer: Joggers in Madrid are not allowed to use the park fountains after midnight.
accepted_answers: Joggers in Madrid are not allowed to use the park fountains after midnight.
explanation_ru: После be allowed нужен инфинитив с to (to use), а не герундий.

prompt: My grandmother never writes her jollof rice recipe down; we were made watch her cook it instead.
answer: My grandmother never writes her jollof rice recipe down; we were made to watch her cook it instead.
accepted_answers: My grandmother never writes her jollof rice recipe down; we were made to watch her cook it instead.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге после make обязательно возвращается частица to: were made to watch.

prompt: On Bonfire Night in Lewes, spectators were seen to cheering as huge figures were carried through the town.
answer: On Bonfire Night in Lewes, spectators were seen cheering as huge figures were carried through the town.
accepted_answers: On Bonfire Night in Lewes, spectators were seen cheering as huge figures were carried through the town.
On Bonfire Night in Lewes, spectators were seen to cheer as huge figures were carried through the town.
explanation_ru: После were seen нельзя совмещать to и -ing. Правильно: were seen cheering (процесс) или were seen to cheer.

prompt: Assam tea pickers are not let to pluck anything other than the top two leaves and a bud.
answer: Assam tea pickers are not allowed to pluck anything other than the top two leaves and a bud.
accepted_answers: Assam tea pickers are not allowed to pluck anything other than the top two leaves and a bud.
explanation_ru: Глагол let не употребляется в пассивном залоге. Вместо are not let to нужно использовать are not allowed to.

prompt: The flour on the dry cast-iron pan was heard sizzle softly as the boy helped his grandfather griddle potato farls.
answer: The flour on the dry cast-iron pan was heard sizzling softly as the boy helped his grandfather griddle potato farls.
accepted_answers: The flour on the dry cast-iron pan was heard sizzling softly as the boy helped his grandfather griddle potato farls.
The flour on the dry cast-iron pan was heard to sizzle softly as the boy helped his grandfather griddle potato farls.
explanation_ru: В пассиве после глагола восприятия hear нельзя ставить голый инфинитив (sizzle) — нужно sizzling или to sizzle.

prompt: In Bali, an ancient system decides when each rice farmer gets water. Farmers cannot open the irrigation gates whenever they want. Which sentence fits best?
options: Farmers are not allowed to open the gates whenever they want.
Farmers are not let to open the gates whenever they want.
Farmers do not allow to open the gates whenever they want.
Farmers are not allowed opening the gates whenever they want.
explanation_ru: Для выражения запрета в пассиве используется be not allowed + to-инфинитив. Let в пассиве не употребляется.

prompt: A senior reviser in Munich was retiring. Her colleagues secretly placed a signed dictionary and freesias on her desk before she arrived. A cleaner noticed them doing it. What can the cleaner say?
options: Her colleagues were seen leave a dictionary on her desk.
Her colleagues were seen leaving a dictionary on her desk.
Her colleagues saw leaving a dictionary on her desk.
Her colleagues were seen to leaving a dictionary on her desk.
explanation_ru: В пассиве после see нельзя использовать голый инфинитив (leave) или сочетание to + -ing. Правильно: were seen leaving.
